allocation_complete.reason: The element has no `allocates`, so this axis is met by definition.

completeness.reason: The limit is enforced; engine-side limiting keeps axle power below the value.

consistency.reason: ARCH_VCU_POWER_MGMT (same parent) also limits the torque request to power limit / speed; in diesel products which element owns the conversion is not reconciled.
consistency.suggestion: State that the VCU only provides the power limit and ENG owns the torque conversion in diesel products (or vice versa).

design_clarity.reason: Concrete: torque at current engine speed, sent as SAE J1939 TSC1.

interface_only.reason: The element has no `allocates`, so this axis is met by definition.

no_value_copy.reason: Names no BMS limit, threshold or timing.

parent_fit.reason: Enforces the traction power limit at the engine in diesel products.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/eng (diesel-only folder); its parent is gated the same (`not bev`) or ungated, so it never exists without its parent.
